item.title: 6 Business Tasks Commonly Handled By Offshore Talent
item.description: When a business is growing, trying to manage every single task in-house can be expensive and time-consuming.

item.title: What Cold Bath Recovery Feels Like Initially
item.description: If you have never taken a cold bath before, it can be a daunting endeavour, mostly because you do not know what to expect.

item.title: ​​7 Mistakes Clients Make When Hiring Lawyers Without Proper Research
item.description: Client-lawyer relationships impact legal representation, which makes hiring a lawyer overly complicated.

item.title: 6 Planning Mistakes That Make Pet Travel Stressful
item.description: Taking your pet on adventures should be fun, but if you don't do your research first, it can become tough very quickly.

item.title: 6 Subtle Differences That Change How Pool Cues Perform
item.description: If you are unfamiliar with the game, most pool cues can be cut from the same strip.

item.title: Letter – Takes Surry’s Hardy to task
item.description: A Surry resident says Supervisor Walter Hardy’s recent remarks violate the county ethics code and urges new board leaders to restore respectful dialogue and accountability.

item.title: Woman charged with animal cruelty in 2024 seizure of 39 dogs, five horses from Carrollton home
item.description: A Newport News woman faces a felony animal cruelty charge and 64 misdemeanors after Isle of Wight County Animal Control seized 40 malnourished dogs and five horses from a Carrollton home in 2024.

item.title: Cost of replacing IWCS bus garage expected by mid-March
item.description: Isle of Wight schools expect a final cost estimate by mid-March for replacing their 1955 bus garage, as design work nears completion on a new multi-bay facility.

item.title: Housing bill roundup: Will pro-development legislation affect IW, Surry?
item.description: Virginia lawmakers have advanced housing bills that could reshape local zoning control.

item.title: Virginia Supreme Court allows redistricting referendum to proceed amid challenge
item.description: Virginia’s Supreme Court let an April 21 congressional redistricting referendum proceed while a GOP challenge continues, ordering briefs from both sides in March and April.
